Rear Speed Sensor & Rotor
On 2WD models, a semiconductor type speed sensor & magnetic rotor integrated with the bearing unit is provided in the axle hub, with the magnetic rotor mounted to the inner race of the bearing unit and the sensor mounted on the cap side.
On 4WD models, a semiconductor type speed sensor & magnetic rotor are provided, with the magnetic rotor mounted to the inner race of the bearing unit and the sensor mounted to the rear axle.
On both 2WD and 4WD models, the operating principle of wheel speed detection is basically the same as that of the front.
